top_signals.title: Exemplar Luxury CEO Says Growth Plan Is on Track
top_signals.summary: Exemplar Luxury Group CEO Geoffroy van Raemdonck says the Saks Fifth Avenue and Neiman Marcus parent company is profitable and aims to grow revenue from $7 billion to $9 billion. He talks about the demand for luxury goods, strengthening relationships with vendors and how the company is preparing for the holiday shopping season. He speaks with Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: The Army Just Did Something Extraordinary To Break China’s Rare Earth Monopoly
top_signals.summary: On November 3, the Pentagon did something it’s never done before. The Army signed a non-binding term sheet to host a commercial rare earth plant on one of its own bases, under a lease that could run past the year 2100. And the company it chose, REalloys (NASDAQ: ALOY), already has a head start on what the Army needs most: turning rare earths into metal outside of China. The site is roughly 200 acres of land inside Utah's Tooele Army Depot, a 43,000-acre installation whose main job is handling ammunition. But it's the length of the deal that…

How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
top_signals.summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.
